evidence.quote: a 40-person Aufguss sauna amphitheatre, a 4°C cold plunge, a Reformer Pilates studio
AndSoul Sanctuary is a club in Shoreditch, east London, built to support the whole you: move, recover and connect.

findings.value: Sauna raves: a DJ plays in the sauna on Friday nights (two listed for October, 16 and 30 Oct). Also a monthly women's ecstatic dance that closes with sound healing, sound and breath sessions such as Sanctum + Sauna, and Friday vinyl evenings at the on-site café.

evidence.quote: Friday night in the sauna with DJ Enrico Argentin. Heat, sound, ice baths and cold plunges.
Friday night in the sauna with DJ Azyre Blue. Heat, sound, ice baths and cold plunges.
Ecstatic Dance Culture return with their monthly women’s dance, closing with a sound healing.
Sanctum brings movement, breath and sound to the Sanctuary, followed by sauna, guided meditation and an ice bath.
Palm Greens opens Bi-weekly on Fridays with Atmosfer: plant-forward small plates, special cocktails, natural wines and hi-fi vinyl sounds by Sonoro

findings.value: Unlimited membership is £149 a month. A single class costs £28, and newcomers can try three classes for £49.

evidence.quote: Unlimited Sanctuary membership is £149 a month and includes over 70 classes a week, Reformer Pilates, and a sauna and cold plunge session every visit.
A single class is £28, and first-time visitors can book three classes for £49, valid for 14 days.
